pages.title: The Stag
pages.text: Florian takes the shape of a great stag. Up close he lowers his antlers and heaves you into the air; from a distance he puts his head down and charges in a straight line you can sidestep. Like Aurelia, he grows faster and hits harder across three stages.

pages.title: Florian's Antler
pages.text: His relic doesn't wear out. Right-click it to call a lesser Florian to fight beside you for about a minute, using the same moves with far less strength. It needs around five minutes to recover before it will answer again.
